title: Authentication

description.platform: How people sign in: sign-up, email verification and the sign-in methods offered to partners.
description.partner: How people sign in on your domains: sign-up, email verification and the sign-in methods the platform offers.

signup.title: Sign-up and verification
signup.verificationValue: Always on (the invitation confirms the email)
signup.note: Nobody creates an account on their own: whoever was invited by the platform, the partner or the workspace team gets in.

description.partner: Button to receive by email a link that signs in without a password, on the login page of your domains, when the platform offers it.

toggle.partner: Show magic link on my domains

label.partner: On the login page of your domains
